review_scope: Primary papers and official model/provider sources relevant to the supplied research plan; not an exhaustive first-in-literature search.

entries.title: Combined LOFAR and DEMON Spectrums for Simultaneous Underwater Acoustic Object Counting and F0 Estimation
entries.access: Primary full text read through web tool; direct HTTP archival request returned 403.
entries.verified_scope: Combines LOFAR and DEMON using a CRNN for simultaneous object counting and fundamental-frequency estimation.
entries.consequence: Dual-view feature fusion, counting, and frequency estimation are established. A conventional learned dual-view baseline is essential.

entries.title: Marine vessels acoustic classification with enhanced machinery and propeller feature extraction, using convolutional neural network
entries.access: Publisher-indexed abstract/section snippets reviewed; complete publisher page returned 403. Crossref publisher-deposited bibliographic metadata archived.
entries.verified_scope: Enhanced machinery features using CAPSE and propeller modulation features from cyclostationary analysis are fused in LOFAR/DEMON representations for CNN vessel classification, including DeepShip and ShipsEar.
entries.consequence: An ordinary dual-view classifier is a relevant strong baseline. Full methodological replication cannot be claimed from snippets.

entries.access: Primary full text retrieved and reviewed.
entries.verified_scope: VLM descriptions and LLM-based validation support knowledge augmentation for marine-mammal spectrogram interpretation and classification.
entries.consequence: Generic spectrogram description and adding external knowledge are not sufficient novelty; this study must evaluate localized numeric support and adaptive inspection.

entries.access: Primary full text retrieved and reviewed, including framework, encoding, data construction, experiments, and discussion.
entries.verified_scope: A physics-aware acoustic encoder aligns log-Mel, line-spectrum, and DEMON representations with Qwen3-4B and LoRA. It learns physical attributes and emits structured numerical descriptions. Experiments use simulated four-vessel source signals with modeled propagation and recorded background noise. Evaluation checks individual physical attributes.
entries.code_audit: No project implementation link was found in the retrieved primary paper; its GitHub links concern arXiv rendering. This does not establish that no implementation exists elsewhere.
entries.consequence: Evidence-grounded descriptions, numeric attributes, representation-specific tokens, and complementary acoustic views are close precedents. This study evaluates bounded reinspection and unresolved component relations; the amended AI-reference gate failed, so independent real accuracy and real-data superiority cannot be claimed.

entries.access: Primary full text retrieved and reviewed, including framework, multichannel encoding, experiment protocol, and limitations.
entries.verified_scope: Direction-guided multichannel encoding combines MVDR, time-frequency and fine-frequency features with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. Structured outputs cover target presence, bearing, frequencies, SNR, range and support scores. Experiments use simulated targets with white or mixed backgrounds; the paper states its test partition was inspected during development and identifies field-recording validation as future work.
entries.code_audit: No project implementation link was found in the retrieved primary paper; no claim of universal code unavailability is made.
entries.consequence: Structured acoustic reporting, field-specific metrics and physical front ends are established. The present mono inspection task differs in available spatial evidence and must avoid unsupported bearing/range claims. A reproducible matched controller comparison is more defensible than a broad novelty assertion.

entries.access: Primary abstract and author repository reviewed.
entries.verified_scope: Synthetic underwater acoustic recognition benchmark with 375051 records, hierarchical labels and paired silent-audio controls.
entries.consequence: Evidence-use interventions are warranted. Synthetic recognition data cannot substitute for real temporal component annotations.

entries.access: Primary arXiv record and author repository indexed record reviewed. OpenReview forum requested browser verification.
entries.verified_scope: Interleaves language-model reasoning and external actions to gather information and update decisions.
entries.consequence: The general reasoning/action pattern is prior work; acoustic formulation and measured utility are the possible contribution.

entries.access: Official model card and model API retrieved.
entries.verified_scope: Open-weight image-text model with tool/visual interaction capabilities described by the publisher; acoustic domain competence is not established by its generic card.
entries.consequence: Pin the actual downloaded revision and record GPU placement, precision, token/image budgets and software versions.

entries.access: Primary arXiv bibliographic record and official checkpoint cards reviewed through web tool on 2026-11-17.
entries.verified_scope: InternVL 3.5 multimodal checkpoints. Official cards identify pretrained Qwen3 components; the actual pinned experiment configurations and revisions are recorded in the annotation freeze.
entries.consequence: Checkpoint diversity does not imply independent annotation errors. Generic model capability does not establish acoustic numeric localization or qualification.

novelty_position: A candidate study of budgeted waveform reinspection and overlap-preserving evidence relations. Real-data advantage and the usefulness of generative action selection remain experimental questions.
prohibited_overclaims: First underwater acoustic language model or physical-evidence report generator
Independent correctness inferred from the verifier's own pass rate
Real-data superiority inferred from synthetic-only results
Exact prior-work reproduction without the corresponding implementation and protocol
